name: Ceiling vault 4 m span x 4 m

joins.grid: spans X between two AN01 walls whose centre lines are at x = -2 / +2 (4 m span); tiles along Y every 4.0 m
joins.pivot: origin (0,0,0) = seating plane on the wall tops (place at the wall top height z = 4.0), centred; the scalloped feet hang 0.06-0.30 m below it to overlap the crooked wall tops and hide the seam
joins.end_profile_note: identical arch section at both ends: feet x = +/-1.36..2.55 at z = -0.30, underside apex z = 0.84, top z = 1.47
joins.scale: for wider spans scale X uniformly (span = 4 m x scale) and keep Y = 1 so the end profiles still tile

notes: thick (0.45-0.6 m) faceted shell covered in details (pebbles, clods, hanging hair rootlets and root tips, clay drips, burrows, cracks, husks, top crumbs/needles), concave underside that domes up toward the middle (ribbed when tiled), feet scalloped low at the 4 corners like the concept; top closed and convex.
